$comment: MB-SERVER-001: pinned INPUTS of the vendored Minecraft Java 26.2 compatibility stack. scripts/vendor-compat.ts rebuilds every vendor/*.tgz from exactly these inputs (registry tarballs verified by sha512, upstream files verified by git blob SHA-1, recorded patches (upstream hunks, plus the MB-SERVER-002 26.2 attribute-id correction derived from the official 26.2 registry), each checked against before/after git blob SHA-1s) and checks the outputs recorded in vendor/compat-lock.json. Nothing here is upstream-released or upstream-tested as a set; see docs/reviews/mb-server-001-compatibility.md.

packages.name: minecraft-data

upstream.status: merged 2026-09-19 into the first-party pc_26_2 branch (not master, not in any minecraft-data / node-minecraft-data release as of 2026-10-06)

overlay.note: Upstream keeps the 26.2 source protocol at pc/latest. It is installed at pc/26.2 instead so the released 3.117.0 pc/latest/proto.yml (26.1's source) stays byte-identical.

edits.description: Insert pc["26.2"] after pc["26.1"], copied from upstream data/dataPaths.json (blob dcc8677ea5997d49f8d6375aa3e364e46027abc1) with proto pointing to pc/26.2 (see the proto.yml note). Every other entry is unchanged.
Append "26.2" after "26.1", as upstream data/pc/common/versions.json (blob c3528a56ceec206e827df379d027500976a9ea99) does.
Regenerated by the package's own bin/generate_data.js from the edited dataPaths.json.

packages.notIncluded: Upstream pc_26_2 also edits README.md, pc/common/features.json (re-adds entityActionUsesStringMapper, which the 3.117.0 release removed) and moves 26.1's proto source to pc/26.1/proto.yml. None of these are applied. Apart from the MB-SERVER-002 attribute key mapper (exact upstream #1254 hunks), 26.1 data, features and sources stay exactly as released in 3.117.0.

patches.scope: 26.1 ClientboundUpdateAttributes key mapper only (data/pc/26.1/protocol.json and its source data/pc/latest/proto.yml). The exact upstream hunks for these two files, with paths prefixed minecraft-data/; the commit's other files (older versions) are not applied.

upstream.status: merged to master 2026-10-03; not in any release as of 2026-10-06

patches.note: The 'after' blobs equal upstream's post-commit blobs (index lines of the upstream diff), i.e. these two files become byte-identical to upstream at 23303d23.

patches.scope: 26.2 ClientboundUpdateAttributes key mapper only (data/pc/26.2/protocol.json and data/pc/26.2/proto.yml).

upstream.status: LOCAL correction; no upstream 26.2 fix exists as of 2026-10-06

patches.derivation: Entry i is the attribute with protocol_id i in the OFFICIAL 26.2 data-generator report registries.json minecraft:attribute (server jar sha1 823e2250d24b3ddac457a60c92a6a941943fcd6a; 40 entries). Labels follow the upstream #1254 convention: the existing library-facing labels (generic.*/player.*/zombie.* such as generic.armor and generic.movement_speed) are kept verbatim; attributes without a legacy label use the bare registry name (the five new 26.2 attributes included). Checked by scripts/verify-version-data.ts and tests/version-compat.test.ts against the official digest.

patches.scope: src/index.js only (maps pc 26.2 to the existing pc/1.18 chunk implementation, as for 26.1); the PR has no other file.
patches.note: 'after' equals the blob of this file at the pull request head commit (byte-identical to the PR head).

patches.scope: lib/features.json only (26.2 joins proportionalLiquidGravity). The PR's new test file is not part of the published package and is not vendored.
patches.note: 'after' equals the blob of this file at the pull request head commit (byte-identical to the PR head).

patches.scope: lib/version.js only. Mineflayer's loader refuses any server newer than the last testedVersions entry; this entry is a LOCAL compatibility admission, not upstream testing. The application reports 26.2 as locally verified (MB-SERVER-001), never as Mineflayer-tested.
patches.note: 'after' equals the blob of this file at the pull request head commit (byte-identical to the PR head).

patches.scope: lib/plugins/entities.js updateAttributes only. Each decoded attribute is ALSO stored under its exact registry resource (bot.registry.attributesArray[].resource, e.g. minecraft:movement_speed) when that resource exists for the connected version and differs from the decoded label; the same object is shared, and the legacy decoded label (generic.movement_speed, generic.armor, ...) stays for other consumers such as explosion.js.

upstream.status: LOCAL correction; upstream mineflayer master and prismarine-physics master still store only the decoded label while physics reads the resource (checked 2026-10-06)

patches.reason: prismarine-physics reads entity.attributes[registry.attributesByName.movementSpeed.resource] = 'minecraft:movement_speed'; without this alias every server movement-speed value/modifier is ignored and physics falls back to its 0.1 default.

notVendored.name: minecraft-protocol
notVendored.reason: Client-only use. PrismarineJS/node-minecraft-protocol#1529 (merged 2026-10-03, unreleased) only changes the nmp SERVER's login success packet; Chunkbot never runs an nmp server. The client takes 26.2 directly from minecraft-data and has no version allowlist.
